sources.title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer Object Detection System - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a modern object detection system that combines the local feature extraction capabilities of CNNs with the global context modeling of Transformers. The model is designed to be lightweight (~10M parameters) while maintaining competitive performance. Key Highlights: Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture Optimized for RTX 3060 GPU (12GB VRAM) Real-time inference capability ...

sources.title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer Models | ai-dawang/PlugNPlay-Modules | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers hybrid architectures that combine convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformer modules within a single model. These hybrid models leverage the complementary strengths of CNNs for local feature extraction and transformers for global context modeling.
